dedupe_keys.name: eesti uleujutusohuga seotud alad ja riskipiirkonnad

description: Eesti üleujutusohuga seotud alad ja riskipiirkonnad is a dataset listed in Estonian National Geoportal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by teenus.maaamet.ee. The maps of the flood risk area shall include geographical areas showing the likely increase in water levels over 10, 50, 100 and 1000 years. The following data shall be provided for each scenario: the extent of the flood, the water level and, in the case of watercourses, the corresponding flow rate. Coverage: EE. The portal shows the English title as "Flood risk areas and risk areas in Estonia" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include üleujutus, INSPIRE, riskipiirkond. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ng-ee.
